finding: Prepregnancy obesity was strongly associated with socioeconomic disadvantage, adverse behavioral factors, and increased risk of adverse maternal and perinatal outcomes, including gestational diabetes, preeclampsia, cesarean delivery, and neonatal complications.
mod_finding: Obese women were more likely to experience cesarean delivery compared to normal-weight women.
